# Baseline A Narrative Synthesis: Chime Financial, Inc.

Case: dev-fintech-chime-2025
Cutoff: 2025-05-13
Input fingerprint: ac31ae60dc5f

## Narrative
- Chime Financial, Inc. is summarized from 2 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2025-05-13.
- The normalized claim list contains 10 cited observations from source classes: company-primary, regulatory-filing.
- As of the 2025-05-13 announcement, Chime said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined.
- Chime announced on 2025-05-13 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO.
- Chime describes itself as a technology company, not a bank, with banking services provided by partner banks.
- Chime reported 8.0 million Active Members for 2024.
- Chime reported 8.6 million Active Members as of 2025-03-31.

## Evidence Notes
- Chime files registration statement for proposed IPO [ev-4cd4b2c602cb]
  - As of the 2025-05-13 announcement, Chime said the number of shares and price range had not yet been determined. (value=not determined; period=instant 2025-05-13)
  - Chime announced on 2025-05-13 that it filed a Form S-1 for a proposed IPO. (value=Form S-1 filed; period=instant 2025-05-13)
  - Chime said it applied to list Class A common stock on Nasdaq under ticker CHYM. (value=CHYM; unit=ticker; period=instant 2025-05-13)
- Chime Financial, Inc. Form S-1 [ev-5fdce7b12f43]
  - Chime describes itself as a technology company, not a bank, with banking services provided by partner banks. (value=technology company with partner-bank services; period=instant 2025-05-13)
  - Chime reported 8.0 million Active Members for 2024. (value=8; unit=millions; period=end 2024-12-31)
  - Chime reported 8.6 million Active Members as of 2025-03-31. (value=8.6; unit=millions; period=instant 2025-03-31)
  - Chime reported USD 34.540 billion of Purchase Volume for the three months ended 2025-03-31. (value=34.54; unit=USD billions; period=start 2025-01-01, end 2025-03-31)
  - Chime reported a USD 25.3 million net loss for 2024. (value=25.3; unit=USD millions net loss; period=end 2024-12-31)
  - Chime reported that 67 percent of Active Members relied on Chime as a primary account relationship as of 2025-03-31. (value=67; unit=percent; period=instant 2025-03-31)
  - The S-1 identifies the registrant as Chime Financial, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001795586. (value=SEC-CIK-0001795586; unit=SEC CIK; period=instant 2025-05-13)

## Limitations
- This baseline performs deterministic evidence summarization only.
- It does not run TRACE route selection, sufficiency gating, valuation logic, or adversarial review.
- It does not claim official contest compliance, benchmark superiority, investment advice, or appraisal status.
- Source use follows the committed policy: Raw source documents, PDFs, cached pages, and scratch downloads stay out of Git unless redistribution rights are explicitly established.
